description: This file defines the interface for a credential management API used in Git, including structures, enums, and function prototypes for handling authentication credentials such as username/password, helper integrations, and credential states.

classes.name: credential
classes.description: Represents a single login credential with associated context, including username, password, helper list, headers, and capabilities.

methods.name: credential_init
methods.description: Initializes a credential structure, setting all fields to default/empty values.

methods.name: credential_clear
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a credential and resets it.

methods.name: credential_fill
methods.description: Fills in username/password or authtype/credential fields by consulting helpers and/or prompting the user.

methods.name: credential_approve
methods.description: Marks credentials as successfully used, allowing helpers to store them.

methods.name: credential_reject
methods.description: Marks credentials as rejected, prompting helpers to purge stored credentials.

methods.name: credential_set_all_capabilities
methods.description: Enables all supported credential flags for a given operation type.

methods.name: credential_clear_secrets
methods.description: Clears sensitive secret data from the credential structure.

methods.name: credential_announce_capabilities
methods.description: Outputs supported capabilities and version info.

methods.name: credential_next_state
methods.description: Prepares the credential for the next helper protocol iteration by updating state headers.

methods.name: credential_has_capability
methods.description: Checks if a specific capability is enabled for a given operation.

methods.name: credential_read
methods.description: Reads credential data from a file stream.

methods.name: credential_write
methods.description: Writes credential data to a file stream.

methods.name: credential_from_url
methods.description: Parses a URL into a credential struct, replacing existing contents.

methods.name: credential_from_url_gently
methods.description: Gently parses a URL into a credential struct, with error handling.

methods.name: credential_match
methods.description: Checks if two credentials match, optionally including password.
